legacyStatistics.pPipeline: single response P -> ItemID repeat mean -> equal-weight ItemID condition mean -> E -> D
legacyStatistics.dInference: unchanged t interval, sign-flip and Holm

humanGap.aggregation: participant-within-cell equal-weight ItemID, then equal-weight participants

stimulusDigest.algorithm: FNV-1a-32 over JavaScript UTF-16 code units

risk.primaryCurve: ItemID-first P -> same-x GroupID mean -> four application GroupIDs equal-weight
risk.baseProbabilityRule: A1/B1 base probabilities are separate curves and separate crossovers; pooled/common crossover prohibited
risk.secondaryCurve: single application GroupID; monetary GroupID is the closest article analogue
risk.coverageRule: ItemID valid repeats >=4/5; comprehensive point covers 4/4 GroupIDs; curve covers all planned x points
risk.rankingDistributionRule: six full rankings by real x point
risk.sourceArticle: l’Haridon, O., & Vieider, F. M. (2019). All over the map: A worldwide comparison of risk preferences. Quantitative Economics, 10(1), 185-215. https://doi.org/10.3982/QE898
